body: Source: GitHub issue #891. Update packages/prosecute/README.md Input shape section to state all four validator rules: (1) provenance.transcript must contain a line matching /^\s*ticket\s*:\s*<id>\s*$/i (prose mention does not satisfy transcriptReferencesTicket) with a minimal valid transcript example; (2) review_packet.clean_worktree must equal the reviewed revision string (the --revision value when supplied); (3) no_findings_attestation is required whenever nothing is verified (including reviews whose only findings are killed or needs-human); (4) evidence paths that resolve inside the worktree must live under .adlc/ or .omo/evidence/ while external paths are allowed. Add positive and negative doc tests in packages/prosecute/test/prosecute-schema-validation.test.mjs.
criteria: packages/prosecute/README.md states all four validator rules and includes a minimal valid transcript example.
Doc test validates the README example transcript and document through runProsecution and verifies replacing the ticket: line with prose fails with provenance.transcript must reference ticket.
out_of_scope: Changing runtime validation rules in packages/prosecute/lib/run.mjs or packages/prosecute/lib/schema.mjs.
title: prosecute: document validator rules and transcript example in README (#891)
